subject: AureliaBank: SIG/SOC2 artifact sync and delivery plan
messages:
From: Laura Gomez <laura.gomez@aureliabank.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: procurements@aureliabank.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial ask — SIG mapping + SOC2/ISO artifacts

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of AureliaBank's third‑party review we need a consolidated SIG control mapping and a sample evidence bundle that covers: SOC 2 CC6 (access controls), SOC 2 CC3 (change management), and ISO 27001 A.10 (cryptographic controls). Our security team wants: 

- A control map that references Redwood product features (routing, KV cache, key management) and clearly maps to SIG control IDs.
- Representative logs for a 90‑day window (authentication, admin actions, and S3 access events).
- Proof of KMS integration showing key rotation policy and a key‑rotation schedule.
- Any third‑party attestations we can point to (SOC2 report location, ISO cert reference).

Can you confirm what you can deliver by next week and whether any items require an NDA/secured transfer? Also, please include a single point of contact and the preferred delivery mechanism (S3 pre‑signed, secure Drive link, or zipped package).

Appreciate it — happy to set a quick call if useful.

Laura
Senior Vendor Risk Analyst
AureliaBank

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Laura Gomez <laura.gomez@aureliabank.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial ask — SIG mapping + SOC2/ISO artifacts

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear list.

We can deliver the SIG control mapping and a representative evidence package that addresses the items you listed. Proposed plan: 

1) Control map (attached): an XLSX that maps SIG IDs to Redwood capabilities, our implementation notes, and links to artifacts.
2) Evidence package (sample logs & configs): a zipped bundle with redacted auth and admin logs covering a 90‑day window + a sample S3 access log extract.
3) KMS proof: a statement of our KMS integration and rotation cadence, plus rotated key timestamps.
4) Attestations: pointer to our SOC2 report (hosted via secure link) and ISO 27001 cert summary.

Delivery method: secure Drive folder with customer‑restricted access (we can also provide a pre‑signed S3 URL for the zip if you prefer).

Owners and deadlines: 
- Control map: Rishi (me) — draft by 2027‑07‑05, final by 2027‑07‑07.
- Evidence bundle pickup: Monica Patel — provide initial bundle by 2027‑07‑06.
- KMS rotation proof & cert pointers: Karthik Iyer — email delivery by 2027‑07‑05.

Attachments included in this email: redwood_control_map_v1.xlsx (draft). The evidence zip will follow via secure link once we confirm access method.

If an NDA is required for logs we can push via DocuSign for a limited 30‑day access grant; I included a placeholder DocuSign link in the metadata. Let me know if Aurelia needs a scan of the SOC2 report or just the cover letter with the report location.

— Rishi
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Gomez <laura.gomez@aureliabank.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: procurements@aureliabank.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial ask — SIG mapping + SOC2/ISO artifacts

Thanks Rishi — that schedule looks reasonable. A couple of clarifications from our reviewers: 

- Retention windows: Aurelia needs confirmation that auth and S3 audit logs are retained for at least 180 days. The 90‑day sample is fine for the package but we need policy confirmation.
- KMS proof: Can you include the policy document that states rotation frequency and the last three rotation timestamps? We will accept a redacted export of the key metadata (no private key material).
- Personnel separation: the SIG reviewer wants a brief note on privileged admin processes and who has access to rotate keys (roles only).

Procurement asked whether Redwood requires any master service agreement addendum or a data processing addendum for logs access. They copied their procurement inbox on this thread.

Finally, please CC your internal legal or compliance lead if you expect to sign additional access paperwork.

Laura

From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Laura Gomez <laura.gomez@aureliabank.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, procurements@aureliabank.com
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial ask — SIG mapping + SOC2/ISO artifacts

Hi Laura — looping in a few specifics and next steps. Quoting your earlier note: 

> Retention windows: Aurelia needs confirmation that auth and S3 audit logs are retained for at least 180 days.

We retain authentication logs and S3 access logs for 365 days by default in our hosted environment. I'll attach a short policy excerpt and include the retention config used for your account type.

> KMS proof: include policy document and last three rotation timestamps.

Karthik is attaching a key‑rotation statement (redacted) plus a CSV of rotation timestamps for the last three rotations. As Rishi noted, no private key material will be shared — just metadata.

> Personnel separation: brief note on privileged admin processes and roles.

We have a least‑privilege admin model enforced via RBAC, and key rotation is restricted to the Security Operations role and an automated rotation service. I'll include the role list and a short crosswalk to SIG control requirements.

Procurement note: We do require a standard DPA for log access where PHI/PII is involved. For the sample bundle (redacted), we can operate under the mutual NDA — but for any persistent access we'll execute the DPA/addendum. Our legal team is aware and can turn around a DPA template in ~3 business days if procurement is ready.

Delivery steps (planned):
- 2027‑07‑05 morning: Drive folder created and control map v1 updated.
- 2027‑07‑06 EOD: evidence zip (redacted logs) available via pre‑signed S3 and Drive copy.
- 2027‑07‑07: KMS rotation CSV and role separation note delivered.

Links to artifacts will be sent to the Aurelia procurement inbox and the vendor risk team with time‑limited access. If you prefer only S3 delivery, confirm and we'll disable Drive.

Attachments included: soc2-log-sample-jan-may.zip (redacted logs), redwood_control_map_v1.xlsx, kms_rotation_statement_redacted.pdf

Thanks — Monica
Director, Customer Assurance
Redwood Inference
